139     def reduce_context(self, agent: "Agent", e: Exception | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
140         """Trim the oldest messages to reduce the conversation context size.

143          - toolResult with no corresponding toolUse
144          - toolUse with no corresponding toolResult
145 
146         Args:
147             agent: The agent whose messages will be reduce.
148                 This list is modified in-place.

150             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
151 
152         Raises:
153             ContextWindowOverflowException: If the context cannot be reduced further.
154                 Such as when the conversation is already minimal or when tool result messages cannot be properly
155                 converted.
156         """
157         messages = agent.messages
158 
159         # Try to truncate the tool result first
160         last_message_idx_with_tool_results = self._find_last_message_with_tool_results(messages)
161         if last_message_idx_with_tool_results is not None and self.should_truncate_results:
162             logger.debug(
163                 "message_index=<%s> | found message with tool results at index", last_message_idx_with_tool_results
164             )
165             results_truncated = self._truncate_tool_results(messages, last_message_idx_with_tool_results)
166             if results_truncated:
167                 logger.debug("message_index=<%s> | tool results truncated", last_message_idx_with_tool_results)
168                 return
169 
170         # Try to trim index id when tool result cannot be truncated anymore
171         # If the number of messages is less than the window_size, then we default to 2, otherwise, trim to window size
172         trim_index = 2 if len(messages) <= self.window_size else len(messages) - self.window_size
173 
174         # Find the next valid trim_index
175         while trim_index < len(messages):
176             if (
177                 # Oldest message cannot be a toolResult because it needs a toolUse preceding it
178                 any("toolResult" in content for content in messages[trim_index]["content"])
179                 or (
180                     # Oldest message can be a toolUse only if a toolResult immediately follows it.
181                     any("toolUse" in content for content in messages[trim_index]["content"])
182                     and trim_index + 1 < len(messages)
183                     and not any("toolResult" in content for content in messages[trim_index + 1]["content"])
184                 )
185             ):
186                 trim_index += 1
187             else:
188                 break
189         else:
190             # If we didn't find a valid trim_index, then we throw
191             raise ContextWindowOverflowException("Unable to trim conversation context!") from e
192 
193         # trim_index represents the number of messages being removed from the agents messages array
194         self.removed_message_count += trim_index
195 
196         # Overwrite message history
197         messages[:] = messages[trim_index:]

223                 )

32             should_truncate_results: Truncate tool results when a message is too large for the model's context window
33             per_turn: Controls when to apply message management during agent execution.
34                 - False (default): Only apply management at the end (default behavior)
35                 - True: Apply management before every model call
36                 - int (e.g., 3): Apply management before every N model calls
37 
38                 When to use per_turn: If your agent performs many tool operations in loops
39                 (e.g., web browsing with frequent screenshots), enable per_turn to proactively
40                 manage message history and prevent the agent loop from slowing down. Start with
41                 per_turn=True and adjust to a specific frequency (e.g., per_turn=5) if needed
42                 for performance tuning.
43 
44         Raises:
45             ValueError: If per_turn is 0 or a negative integer.
46         """
47         super().__init__()
48 
49         self.window_size = window_size
50         self.should_truncate_results = should_truncate_results
51         self.per_turn = per_turn
52         self._model_call_count = 0
53 
54     def register_hooks(self, registry: "HookRegistry", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
55         """Register hook callbacks for per-turn conversation management.
56 
57         Args:
58             registry: The hook registry to register callbacks with.
59             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
60         """
61         super().register_hooks(registry, **kwargs)
62 
63         # Always register the callback - per_turn check happens in the callback
64         registry.add_callback(BeforeModelCallEvent, self._on_before_model_call)
65 
66     def _on_before_model_call(self, event: BeforeModelCallEvent) -> None:
67         """Handle before model call event for per-turn management.
68 
69         This callback is invoked before each model call. It tracks the model call count and applies message management
70         based on the per_turn configuration.
71 
72         Args:
73             event: The before model call event containing the agent and model execution details.
74         """
75         # Check if per_turn is enabled
76         if self.per_turn is False:
77             return
78 
79         self._model_call_count += 1
80 
81         # Determine if we should apply management
82         should_apply = False
83         if self.per_turn is True:
84             should_apply = True
85         elif isinstance(self.per_turn, int) and self.per_turn > 0:
86             should_apply = self._model_call_count % self.per_turn == 0
87 
88         if should_apply:
89             logger.debug(
90                 "model_call_count=<%d>, per_turn=<%s> | applying per-turn conversation management",
91                 self._model_call_count,
92                 self.per_turn,
93             )
94             self.apply_management(event.agent)
95 
96     def get_state(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
97         """Get the current state of the conversation manager.
98 
99         Returns:
100             Dictionary containing the manager's state, including model call count for per-turn tracking.
101         """
102         state = super().get_state()
103         state["model_call_count"] = self._model_call_count
104         return state

106     def restore_from_session(self, state: dict[str, Any]) -> list | None:
107         """Restore the conversation manager's state from a session.
108 
109         Args:
110             state: Previous state of the conversation manager
111 
112         Returns:
113             Optional list of messages to prepend to the agent's messages.
114         """
115         result = super().restore_from_session(state)
116         self._model_call_count = state.get("model_call_count", 0)

119     def apply_management(self, agent: "Agent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
120         """Apply the sliding window to the agent's messages array to maintain a manageable history size.
121 
122         This method is called after every event loop cycle to apply a sliding window if the message count
123         exceeds the window size.
124 
125         Args:
126             agent: The agent whose messages will be managed.
127                 This list is modified in-place.
128             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
129         """
130         messages = agent.messages
131 
132         if len(messages) <= self.window_size:
133             logger.debug(
134                 "message_count=<%s>, window_size=<%s> | skipping context reduction", len(messages), self.window_size
135             )
136             return
137         self.reduce_context(agent)
138 
139     def reduce_context(self, agent: "Agent", e: Exception | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
140         """Trim the oldest messages to reduce the conversation context size.
141 
142         The method handles special cases where trimming the messages leads to:
143          - toolResult with no corresponding toolUse
144          - toolUse with no corresponding toolResult
145 
146         Args:
147             agent: The agent whose messages will be reduce.
148                 This list is modified in-place.
149             e: The exception that triggered the context reduction, if any.
150             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
151 
152         Raises:
153             ContextWindowOverflowException: If the context cannot be reduced further.
154                 Such as when the conversation is already minimal or when tool result messages cannot be properly
155                 converted.
156         """
157         messages = agent.messages
158 
159         # Try to truncate the tool result first
160         last_message_idx_with_tool_results = self._find_last_message_with_tool_results(messages)
161         if last_message_idx_with_tool_results is not None and self.should_truncate_results:
162             logger.debug(
163                 "message_index=<%s> | found message with tool results at index", last_message_idx_with_tool_results
164             )
165             results_truncated = self._truncate_tool_results(messages, last_message_idx_with_tool_results)
166             if results_truncated:
167                 logger.debug("message_index=<%s> | tool results truncated", last_message_idx_with_tool_results)
168                 return
169 
170         # Try to trim index id when tool result cannot be truncated anymore
171         # If the number of messages is less than the window_size, then we default to 2, otherwise, trim to window size
172         trim_index = 2 if len(messages) <= self.window_size else len(messages) - self.window_size
173 
174         # Find the next valid trim_index
175         while trim_index < len(messages):
176             if (
177                 # Oldest message cannot be a toolResult because it needs a toolUse preceding it
178                 any("toolResult" in content for content in messages[trim_index]["content"])
179                 or (
180                     # Oldest message can be a toolUse only if a toolResult immediately follows it.
181                     any("toolUse" in content for content in messages[trim_index]["content"])
182                     and trim_index + 1 < len(messages)
183                     and not any("toolResult" in content for content in messages[trim_index + 1]["content"])
184                 )
185             ):
186                 trim_index += 1
187             else:
188                 break
189         else:
190             # If we didn't find a valid trim_index, then we throw
191             raise ContextWindowOverflowException("Unable to trim conversation context!") from e
192 
193         # trim_index represents the number of messages being removed from the agents messages array
194         self.removed_message_count += trim_index
195 
196         # Overwrite message history
197         messages[:] = messages[trim_index:]
198 
199     def _truncate_tool_results(self, messages: Messages, msg_idx: int) -> bool:
200         """Truncate tool results in a message to reduce context size.
201 
202         When a message contains tool results that are too large for the model's context window, this function
203         replaces the content of those tool results with a simple error message.
204 
205         Args:
206             messages: The conversation message history.
207             msg_idx: Index of the message containing tool results to truncate.
208 
209         Returns:
210             True if any changes were made to the message, False otherwise.
211         """
212         if msg_idx >= len(messages) or msg_idx < 0:
213             return False
214 
215         message = messages[msg_idx]
216         changes_made = False
217         tool_result_too_large_message = "The tool result was too large!"
218         for i, content in enumerate(message.get("content", [])):
219             if isinstance(content, dict) and "toolResult" in content:
220                 tool_result_content_text = next(
221                     (item["text"] for item in content["toolResult"]["content"] if "text" in item),
222                     "",
223                 )
224                 # make the overwriting logic togglable
225                 if (
226                     message["content"][i]["toolResult"]["status"] == "error"
227                     and tool_result_content_text == tool_result_too_large_message
228                 ):
229                     logger.info("ToolResult has already been updated, skipping overwrite")
230                     return False
231                 # Update status to error with informative message
232                 message["content"][i]["toolResult"]["status"] = "error"
233                 message["content"][i]["toolResult"]["content"] = [{"text": tool_result_too_large_message}]
234                 changes_made = True
235 
236         return changes_made
237 
238     def _find_last_message_with_tool_results(self, messages: Messages) -> int | None:
239         """Find the index of the last message containing tool results.
240 
241         This is useful for identifying messages that might need to be truncated to reduce context size.
242 
243         Args:
244             messages: The conversation message history.
245 
246         Returns:
247             Index of the last message with tool results, or None if no such message exists.
248         """
249         # Iterate backwards through all messages (from newest to oldest)
250         for idx in range(len(messages) - 1, -1, -1):
251             # Check if this message has any content with toolResult
252             current_message = messages[idx]
253             has_tool_result = False
254 
255             for content in current_message.get("content", []):
256                 if isinstance(content, dict) and "toolResult" in content:
257                     has_tool_result = True
258                     break
259 
260             if has_tool_result:
261                 return idx
262 
263         return None
